text_block_list.text:
Transcend used to run purely for fun, but 
not anymore. Carrying something on her 
shoulders, running while feeling the 
presence of others, she found an unknown 
thrill.

"Having delivered an impressive run in the 
JBC Classic, she had a clear reason to 
give it her all. That fierce resolve 
seemed to resonate with her rivals as 
well."

Thus, data on the Big Three was gathered 
once more, and Transcend returned to the 
form she had before the disaster.

Next is the Champions Cup, which was 
decided upon at the start of the year. By 
dedicating an unprecedented back-to-back 
victory to the disaster-stricken areas, 
she would prove her complete resurgence.
